V/s.
 The State of Maharashtra.

---
 Mr. Tuushar N. Sonawane, Advocate for Applicant.
Mr. Sukanta Karmakar, App for Respondent/State.
Psi D.D. Jadhav, Mangaon Police Station.

---
 Coram : Ashwin D. Bhobe, J.
Date : 30th January, 2026.
P.C. :

1. Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mr. Sukanta Karmakar, learned APP for the State.
2. By the present Application, the Applicant is seeking to quash FIR in a case bearing Crime No. 321 of 2025 registered under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275, 3(5) of Bhartiya Nyay Sanhita 2023 with Sections 27(2)(e) 26(1), 26(2), 26(4), 27(3)(d), 59(iii)
3.APL126.2026.doc of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, registered with Mangaon Police Station, District Raigad on 20.12.2025.
3. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Sushant Sharad Nakti vs State Of Maharashtra on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22732124/
1 Petition No. 4078 of 2025, Criminal Writ Petition No. 280 of 2025, and Criminal Writ Petition No. 3444 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Writ Sushant Sharad Nakti vs State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Application/Petition, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.
4. Mr. Sukanta Karmakar, learned APP for the Respondent State does not dispute the contentions raised and urged by Mr. Tuushar Sonawane,
He submits that the issue involved in the present Application is subject matter of the Petitions referred by the Applicant in the present proceedings.
He submits that the present Application filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short 'BNSS') be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions.
5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the 3.APL126.2026.doc Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid three Petitions be also granted in this Application.

Mr. Sukanta Karmakar,
learned APP for the Respondent does not object to the said request.
6. In view of the above, further proceedings arising out of Crime No. 321 of 2025 registered with Mangaon Police Station, District Raigad on 20.12.2025 are stayed qua the Applicant.
Tag this Application along with Criminal Writ Petition No. 4078 of 2025, Criminal Writ Petition No. 280 of 2025, and Criminal Writ Petition No. 3444 of 2025.

(ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.)
